pe6:1.1: buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ sāsanaṃ tividhena saṅgahaṃ gacchati: khandhesu dhātusu āyatanesu.
pe6:1.3: dasarūpaāyatanāni: cakkhu rūpā ca, yāva kāyo phoṭṭhabbā ca. ayaṃ rūpakkhandho,
pe6:1.4: tattha cha vedanākāyā vedanākkhandho: cakkhusamphassajā vedanā, yāva manosamphassajā vedanā, ayaṃ vedanākkhandho.
pe6:1.5: tattha cha saññākāyā saññākkhandho: rūpasaññā, yāva dhammasaññā, ime cha saññākāyā. ayaṃ saññākkhandho.
pe6:1.6: tattha cha cetanākāyā saṅkhārakkhandho: rūpasañcetanā, yāva dhammasañcetanā, ime cha cetanākāyā, ayaṃ saṅkhārakkhandho.
pe6:1.7: tattha cha viññāṇakāyā viññāṇakkhandho: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, yāva manoviññāṇaṃ, ime cha viññāṇakāyā, ayaṃ viññāṇakkhandho.
pe6:2.2: aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ saññā anattāti, esā etesaṃ pariññā.
pe6:2.4: samūhattho khandhattho, puñjattho khandhattho, rāsattho khandhattho,
pe6:2.5: taṃ yathā dabbakkhandho vanakkhandho dārukkhandho aggikkhandho udakakkhandho vāyukkhandho. iti evaṃ khandhesu sabbasaṅgahoca evaṃ khandhattho.
pe6:3.1: tattha aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo: cakkhudhātu rūpadhātu cakkhuviññāṇadhātu …pe…
pe6:3.4: tāsaṃ pariññā: aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ saññā anattāti, esā etāsaṃ pariññā.
pe6:3.8: evaṃ pañcasu dhātūsu, puna rāgavacacchedattho dhātuattho.
pe6:3.10: evaṃ pañcasu, punarāha ekanti pakatyatthena dhātuatthoti vuccate.
pe6:3.11: taṃ yathā: pakatiyā ayaṃ puriso pittiko semhiko cātiko sannipātikoti. evaṃpakati cakkhudhātu. dassanampi yā ca sabbesu indriyesu …pe…
pe6:4.3: cakkhāyatanaṃ, yāva manāyatananti ajjhattikaṃ, rūpāyatanaṃ. yāva dhammāyatananti bāhiraṃ.
pe6:4.6: aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ saññā anattāti, esā etesaṃ pariññā.
pe6:4.7: api ca dvidhā pariññā: ñātapariññā ca pahānapariññā ca.
pe6:4.8: tattha ñātapariññā nāma: aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ saññā anattāti, esā ñātapariññā
pe6:4.12: yathā suvaṇṇākaro ratanākaro yathā dvīhi tehi ākārehi te te gāvā uttiṭṭhanti,
pe6:4.13: evaṃ etehi cittacetasikā gāvā uttiṭṭhanti kammakilesā dukkhadhammā ca.
pe6:4.15: yathā rañño āyadānehi āyo bhavati. evaṃ āyadānattho āyatanattho.
pe6:5.1: cattāri ariyasaccāni: dukkhaṃ samudayo nirodho maggo ca.
pe6:5.2: yathā dukkhaṃ samāsena khandhasarīraṃ mānasaṃ ca, samudayo samāsena avijjā ca taṇhā ca, nirodho samāsena vijjā ca vimutti ca maggo samāsena samatho ca vipassanā ca.
pe6:6.2: cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, yāva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo. evamete sattatiṃsa bodhipakkhikā dhammā.
pe6:6.3: ye dhammā atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ buddhānaṃ sāvakānaṃ ca nibbānaṃ saṃvattantīti. yo maggo cattāro satipaṭṭhānā.
pe6:6.11: indattho indriyattho, ādhipateyyattho indriyattho, pasādattho indriyattho, asādhāraṇaṃ kassa kiriyattho indriyattho.
pe6:6.12: anavapariyattho balattho, thāmattho balattho, upādāyattho balattho, upanthambhanattho balattho.
pe6:7.5: tattha aṭṭhaṅgiko maggoti: khandho: sīlakkhandho ca samādhikkhandho ca paññākkhandho ca,
pe6:7.6: tattha yā ca sammāvācā yo ca sammākammanto yo ca sammāājīvo, ayaṃ sīlakkhandho.
pe6:7.7: yā ca sammāsati yo ca sammāvāyāmo yo ca sammāsamādhi, ayaṃ samādhikkhandho.
pe6:7.8: yo ca sammāsaṅkappo yā ca sammādiṭṭhi, ayaṃ paññākkhandho.
pe6:8.1: tattha yogāvacaro sīlakkhandhe ṭhito dosaṃ akusalaṃ na upādiyati, dosānusayaṃ samūhanti, dosasallaṃ uddharati, dukkhavedanaṃ parijānāti, kāmadhātuṃ samatikkamati.
pe6:8.2: samādhikkhandhe ṭhito lobhaṃ akusalaṃ na upādiyati, rāgānusayaṃ samūhanti, lobhasallaṃ uddharati, sukhavedanaṃ parijānāti, rūpadhātuṃ samatikkamati.
pe6:8.3: paññākkhandhe ṭhito mohaṃ akusalaṃ na upādiyati, avijjānusayaṃ samūhanti, mohasallaṃ diṭṭhisallañca uddharati, adukkhamasukhavedanaṃ parijānāti, arūpadhātuṃ samatikkamati.
pe6:8.4: iti tīhi khandhehi tīṇi akusalamūlāni na upādiyati, cattāri sallāni uddharati, tisso vedanā parijānāti tedhātukaṃ samatikkamati.
pe6:9.2: yaṃ catusu ariyasaccesu aññāṇanti vitthārena, yathā so pāṇasajjesu kathaṃkathā kātabbaṃ.
pe6:9.4: cha viññāṇakāyā. vedanā saññā cetanā phasso manasikāro idaṃ nāmaṃ.
pe6:9.7: iti purimakaṃ ca nāmaṃ idaṃ ca rūpaṃ tadubhayaṃ nāmarūpanti vuccati.
pe6:9.8: tattha chaḷāyatananti: cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni, cakkhu ajjhattikaṃ āyatanaṃ, yāva mano ajjhattikaṃ āyatanaṃ.
pe6:9.9: phassoti cha phassakāyā, cakkhusamphasso yāva manosamphassoti phasso. vedanāti:
pe6:9.12: upādānanti cattāri upādānāni: kāmūpādānaṃ diṭṭhūpādānaṃ sīlabbatūpādānaṃ attavādūpādānanti upādānaṃ.
pe6:9.13: bhavoti tayo bhavā, kāmabhavo rūpabhavo arūpabhavo.
pe6:9.15: yā paṭhamaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhātūnaṃ paṭhamaṃ āyatanānaṃ uppatti jāti sañjāti okkanti abhinibbatti khandhānaṃ pātubhāvo, ayaṃ jāti.
pe6:9.17: jarā nāma yaṃ taṃ khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ vicaṇṇatā bhaggo yā jarā hīyanā parihīyanā āyuno hāni saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripākā upanāho paripāko, ayaṃ jarā.
pe6:9.19: maraṇaṃ nāma, yā tasmiṃ sattanikāye tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ cuti cavanatā maraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānaṃ bhedo kāyassa nikkhepo jīvitindriyassa upacchedo, idaṃ maraṇaṃ,
pe6:9.20: iti purimikā ca jarā idaṃ ca maraṇaṃ tadubhayaṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ.
pe6:10.1: tattha andhakāratimisā yathābhūtaṃ appajānana lakkhaṇā avijjā saṅkhārānaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ:
pe6:10.4: vatthu saviññattilakkhaṇaṃ viññāṇaṃ, taṃ nāmarūpassa padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:10.12: khandhānaṃ pātubhāvalakkhaṇā jāti, sā jarāya padaṭṭhānaṃ
pe6:10.18: vācā nicchāraṇalakkhaṇo paridevo, so upāyāsassa padaṭṭhānaṃ
pe6:11.1: nava padāni yattha sabbo akusalapakkho saṅgahaṃ samosaraṇaṃ gacchati,
pe6:11.3: dve mūlakilesā tīṇi akusalamūlāni, cattāro vipallāsā.
pe6:11.4: tattha dve mūlakilesā, avijjā ca bhavataṇhā ca, tīṇi akusalamūlāni: lobho doso moho ca,
pe6:11.6: ‘anicce nicca’nti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso, dukkhe sukhanti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso, anattani attāti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso, asubhe subhanti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.
pe6:12.1: tattha avijjā nāma: catusu ariyasaccesu yathābhūtaṃ aññāṇaṃ, ayaṃ avijjā,
pe6:12.2: bhavataṇhā nāma: so bhavesu rāgo sārāgo icchā mucchā patthanā nandri ajjhosānaṃ apariccāgo, ayaṃ bhavataṇhā.
pe6:13.2: yo tesu tesu paravatthusu paradabbesu paraṭṭhānesu parasāpateyyesu parapariggahesu lobho lubbhanā icchā patthanā nandi ajjhosānaṃ apariccāgo; ayaṃ lobhoakusalamūlaṃ.
pe6:13.4: lobhajassa akusalassa kāyakammassa vacīkammassa manokammassa taṃsampayuttānaṃ ca cittacetasikānaṃ dhammānaṃ mūlaṃ.
pe6:14.2: yo sattesu aghato akkhanti appaccayo vyāpādo padoso anatthakāmatā cetaso paṭighāto, ayaṃ doso akusalamūlaṃ
pe6:15.2: dosajassa akusalassa kāyakammassa vacīkammassa manokammassa taṃsampayuttānaṃ ca cittacetasikānaṃ dhammānaṃ mūlaṃ.
pe6:16.2: yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ anabhisamayo asampajjagāho appaṭivedho moho muyhanā sammoho sammuyhanā avijjā tamo ajhakāro āvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ chadanaṃ avacchadanaṃ apasaṭṭhāgamanaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ayaṃ moho akusalamūlaṃ.
pe6:17.2: mohajassa akusalassa kāyakammassa vacīkammassa manokammassa, taṃsampayuttānaṃ ca cittacetasikānaṃ dhammānaṃ mūlaṃ.
pe6:18.1: tattha vipallāsā jānitabbā, vipallāsānaṃ vatthu jānitabbaṃ,
pe6:18.3: tattha eko vipallāso, cattāri, vipallāsavatthuni, tīṇi vipallāsāni,
pe6:18.4: katamo eko vipallāso ca, yena paṭipakkhena vipallāsitaṃ gaṇhāti
pe6:18.5: anicce niccanti dukkhe sukhanti anattani attāti asubhe subha’nti ayaṃ eko vipallāso.
pe6:21.1: tattha manāpike vatthumhi indriyatthe vaṇṇāyatane vā yo nimittassa uggāho, ayaṃ saññāvipallāso.
pe6:21.2: tattha viparītacittassa vatthumhi sati viññatti, cittavipallāso.
pe6:21.3: tattha viparītacittassa tamhi rūpe asubhe subha’nti yā khanti ruci upekkhanā nicchayo diṭṭhi nidassanaṃ santīraṇā, ayaṃ diṭṭhivipallāso.
pe6:21.4: tattha vatthubhedena kāyesu dvādasa vipallāsā bhavanti:
pe6:21.5: tayo kāye tayo vedanāya tayo citte tayo dhamme cattāro saññāvipallāsā cattāro cittavipallāsā cattāro diṭṭhivipallāsā, āyatanūpacayato cakkhuviññāṇasaññāsamaṅgissa rūpesu dvādasa vipallāsā, yāva manoviññāṇasaññāsamaṅgissa dhammesu dvādasa vipallāsā, cha dvādasakā cattāri vipallāsā bhavanti.
pe6:21.6: ārammaṇanānattato hi aparimitasaṅkheyyānaṃ sattānaṃ aparimitasaṅkheyyā vipallāsā bhavanti bhīnukkaṭṭhamajjhīmatāya.
pe6:22.4: yo saññākkhandho ca saṃkhārakkhandho ca te dhammā attabhāvavatthu.
pe6:22.12: tattha catunnaṃ vipallāsānaṃ samugghātanatthaṃ bhagavā cattāro satipaṭṭhāne deseti paññapeti, kāye kāyānupassī viharanto asubhe subha’nti
pe6:22.13: vipallāsaṃ samugghāteti. evaṃ vedanāsu - citte - dhammesu ca kātabbaṃ.
pe6:23.1: tattha andhakāratimisā appaṭivedhalakkhaṇā avijjā, tassā vipallāyā padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:23.4: idha civādalakkhaṇo doso, tassa pāṇātipāto padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:23.6: saṅkhatānāṃ dhammānaṃ avināsaggahanalakkhaṇā niccasaññā, tassā sabbasaṅkhārā padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:23.8: dhammesu upagamanalakkhaṇā attasaññā, tassā abhiṅkāro padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:23.10: etehi navahi padehi uddiṭṭhehi sabbo akusalapakkho niddiṭṭho bhavati, so ca kho bahussutena sakkā jānituṃ. no appassutena, paññavatā no duppaññena, yuttena no ayuttena.
pe6:24.1: nava padāni kusalāni yattha sabbo kusalapakkho saṅgahaṃ samosaraṇaṃ gacchati
pe6:24.3: samatho vipassanā alobho adoso amoho aniccasaññā dukkhasaññā anattasaññā asubhasaññā ca.
pe6:25.2: yā cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti ṭhānaṃ paṭṭhānaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ samādhi samādhānaṃ avikkhepo avippaṭihāro vūpasamo manaso ekaggaṃ cittassa, ayaṃ samatho.
pe6:26.2: khandhesu vā dhātusu vā āyatanesu vā nāmarūpesu vā paṭiccasamamuppādesu vā paṭiccasamuppannesu vā dhammesu dukkhe vā samudaye vā nirodhe vā magge vā kusalākusalesu vā dhammesu sāvajjānavajjesu vā kaṇhasukkesu vā sevitabbāsevitabbesu vā yo yathābhūtaṃ vicayo pavicayo vīmaṃsā parivimaṃsā. gāhanā aggāhanā pariggāhanā vittena parivittanā tulanā upaparikkhā ñāṇaṃ vijjā cakkhu buddhi medhā paññā obhāgo āleko ābhā pabhā khaggo nārāvo dhammavicayasambejjhaṅgo sammādiṭṭhi maggaṅgaṃ, ayaṃ vipassanā.
pe6:26.3: kenesā vipassanā iti vuccati: vividhā vā phasā passanāti tasmā phasā vipassanāti muccati.
pe6:26.4: dvidhā cesā hi vipassanā dhammavippanāti. dvidhā imāya passati: subhañca asubhañca kaṇhañca sukkañca sevitabbañca asevitabbañca kammañca vipākañca khandhañca cimokkhañca ācayañca apacayañca pavattiñca nivattiñca saṅkilesañca vodānañca evaṃ vipassanāti vuccati
pe6:26.5: atha vā vi’iti upasaggo passanāti attho, tasmā vipassanāti vuccate, ayaṃ vipassanā.
pe6:27.1: tattha dve rogā sattānaṃ: avijjā ca bhavataṇhā ca, etesaṃ dvinnaṃ rogānaṃ nighātāya bhagavatā dve bhesajjāni vuttāni: samatho ca vipassanā ca,
pe6:27.2: imāni dve bhesajjāni paṭisevanto dve aroge sacichikaroti: rāgavirāgaṃ cetatovimuttiṃ avijjāvirāgaṃ ca paññāvimuttiṃ.
pe6:27.3: tattha taṇhārogassa samatho bhesajjaṃ, rāgavirāgā cetovimutti arogaṃ.
pe6:27.4: avijjārogassa vipassanā bhesajjaṃ, avijjāvirāgā paññāvimutti arogaṃ.
pe6:27.5: evaṃ hi bhagavā cāha: “dve dhammā pariññeyyā: nāmaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca dve dhammā pahātabbā: avijjā ca bhavataṇhā ca, dve dhammā bhāvetabbā: samatho ca vipassanā ca, dve dhammā sacchikātabbā: vijjā ca vimutti cā”ti.
pe6:27.6: tattha samathaṃ bhāvento rūpaṃ parijānāti, rūpaṃ parijānanto taṇhaṃ pajahati, taṇhaṃ pajahanto rāgavirāgā cetovimuttiṃ sacchikaroti vipassanaṃ bhāvento nāmaṃ parijānāti, nāmaṃ parijānanto avijjaṃ pajahati, avijjaṃ pajahanto avijjāvirāgā paññāvimuttiṃ sacchikaroti.
pe6:27.7: yadā bhikkhuno dve dhammā pariññātā bhavanti nāmañca rūpañca, tadāssa dve dhammā pahīnā bhavanti avijjā ca bhavataṇhā ca,
pe6:27.8: dve dhammā bhāvitā bhavanti samatho ca vipassanā ca, dve dhammā sacchikatā bhavanti vijjā ca vimutti ca.
pe6:27.11: tassa āyupariyādānā jīvitindriyassa uparodhā idaṃ ca dukkhaṃ nirujjhati, aññaṃ ca dukkhaṃ na uppajjati.
pe6:27.12: tattha yo imesaṃ khandhānaṃ dhātuāyatanānaṃ appaṭisandhi apātubhāvo, ayaṃ anupādisesā nibbānadhātu.
pe6:28.2: yaṃdhātuko alobho alubbhanā alubbhitattaṃ anicchā apatthanā akantā anajjhosānaṃ,
pe6:28.5: alojassa kusalassa kāyakammassa vacīkammassa manokammassa taṃsampayuttānaṃ ca cittacetasikānaṃ dhammānaṃ mūlaṃ.
pe6:28.6: atha vā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo kusalanti vuccati, so tiṇṇaṃ maggaṅgānaṃ mūlaṃ,
pe6:28.7: katamesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ: sammāsaṅkappassa sammāvāyāmassa sammāsamādhissa ca, imesaṃ mūlanti tasmā kusalamūlanti vuccati.
pe6:29.2: yo sattesu vā saṅkhāresu vā anāghāto appaṭighāto abyāpatti abyāpādo adoso mettā mettāyanā atthakāmatā hitakāmatā cetaso padāso, ayaṃ adoso kusalamūlaṃ.
pe6:29.4: adosajassa kusalassa kāyakammassa vacīkammassa manokammassa taṃsampayuttānaṃ ca cittacetasikānaṃ dhammānaṃ mūlaṃ.
pe6:29.7: sammāvācāya sammākammantassa sammāājīvassa ca imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ maggaṅgānaṃ mūlaṃ, tasmā kusalamūlanti vuccati.
pe6:30.2: yaṃ catusu ariyasaccesu yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ abhisamayo sammā ca paccāgamo paṭivedho amoho asammuyhanā asammoho vijjā pakāso āloko anāvaraṇaṃ sekkhānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ, ayaṃ amoho kusalamūlaṃ.
pe6:30.4: amohajassa kusalassa kāyakammassa vacīkammassa manokammassa taṃsampayuttānaṃ ca cittacetasikānaṃ dhammānaṃ mūlaṃ.
pe6:30.7: sammādiṭṭhiyā ca sammāsatiyā ca imesaṃ dvinnaṃ maggaṅgānaṃ mūlaṃ, tasmā kusalamūlanti vuccati.
pe6:31.1: evaṃ imehi, tīhi kusalamūlehi aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo yojetabbe.
pe6:32.2: “sabbe saṅkhārā uppādavayadhammino”ti yā saññā sañjānanā vavatthapanā uggāho, ayaṃ aniccasaññā.
pe6:32.4: aniccasaññāya bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya aṭṭhasu lokadhammesu cittaṃ nānusandhati na sandhati na saṇṭhahati, upekkhā vā paṭikkulatā vā saṇṭhahati. ayamassā nissando.
pe6:33.2: “sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhā”ti yā saññā sañjānanā vavatthapanā uggaho, ayaṃ dukkhasaññā
pe6:33.4: dukkhasaññāya bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya ālasse sampamādo vimbhaye ca cittaṃ nānusandhati ka sandhati na saṇṭhahati, upekkhā vā paṭikkulatā vā saṇṭhahati. ayamassā nissando.
pe6:34.2: “sabbe dhammā anattā”ti yā saññā sañjānanā vavatthapanā uggāho, ayaṃ anattasaññā.
pe6:34.3: tassā ko nissando: anattasaññāya bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya abhiṅkāro cittaṃ nānusandhati na sandhati, mamiṅkāro na saṇṭhahati, upekkhā vā paṭikkūlatā vā saṇṭhahati, ayamassā nissando.
pe6:35.2: “sattasaṅkhārā asubhā”ti yā saññā sañjānanā vavatthapanā uggāho, ayaṃ asubhaññā.
pe6:35.4: asubhasaññāya bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya subhanimitte cittaṃ nānusandhati na sandhati na saṇṭhahati, upekkhā vā paṭikkulatā vā saṇṭhahatī, ayamassā nissando.
pe6:36.1: tattha pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ pariññā bhagavatā desitā, yā tattha asubhasaññā rūpakkhandhassa pariññattaṃ dukkhasaññā vedanākkhandhassa pariññattaṃ, anattasaññā saññākkhandhassa saṅkhārakkhandhassa pariññattaṃ, aniccasaññā viññāṇakkhandhassa pariññattaṃ.
pe6:36.2: tattha samathena taṇhaṃ samugghāteti, vipassanāya avijjaṃ samugghāteti, adosena dosaṃ samugghāteti, amohena mohaṃ samugghāteti. aniccasaññāya niccasaññaṃ samugghāteti, dukkhasaññāya sukhasaññaṃ samugghāteti, anattasaññāya attasaññaṃ samugghāteti, asubhasaññāya subhasaññaṃ samugghāteti.
pe6:37.2: sabbadhammaṃ yathābhūtaṃ paṭivedhalakkhaṇā vipassanā, tassā sabbaneyyaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:37.3: icchāpaṭisaṃharaṇalakkhaṇo alobho, tassa adinnādānā veramaṇī padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:37.4: avyāpādalakkhaṇo adoso, kassa pāṇātipātā veramaṇī padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:37.6: saṅkhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ vināsaggahaṇalakkhaṇā aniccasaññā, tassā udayabbayo padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:37.10: imesu navasu padesu upadiṭṭhesu sabbo kulasapakkho upadiṭṭho bhavati, so ca bahussutena sakkā jānituṃ no appassutena, paññavatā no duppaññena, yuttena no ayuttenā’ti.
pe6:38.1: tattha niccasaññādhimuttassa aparāparaṃ cittaṃ paṇāmentassa satiṃ appaccavekkhakkhato aniccasaññā na upaṭṭhāti, pañcasu kāmaguṇesu sukhassādādhimuttassa iriyāpathassa agatiṃ appaccavekkhato dukkhasaññā na upaṭṭhāti, khandhadhātuāyatanesu attādhimuttassa nānādhātuanekadhātuvinibbhogaṃ appaccavekkhato anattasaññā na upaṭṭhāti, vaṇṇasaṇṭhānābhiratassa kāye subhādhimuttassa ca vipaṭicchannā asubhasaññā na upaṭṭhāti.
pe6:39.3: evañhi vuttaṃ bhagavatā: “saddhindriyaṃ bhikkhave kuhiṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ: catusu sotāpattiyaṅgesu kusalesu dhammesu”.
pe6:40.3: yathā vuttaṃ bhagavatā: “viriyindriyaṃ bhikkhave kuhiṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ: catusu sammappadhānesu”.
pe6:41.3: yathā vuttaṃ bhagavatā: “satindriyaṃ bhikkhave kuhiṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ, catusu satipaṭṭhānesu”.
pe6:42.1: ekaggalakkhaṇo samādhi, avikkhepapaccupaṭṭhāno, tassa cattāri jhānāni padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:42.2: yathā vuttaṃ bhagavatā: “samādhindriyaṃ bhikkhave kuhiṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ catusu jhānesu”.
pe6:43.1: pajānanalakkhaṇā paññā, bhūtatthasantīraṇapaccupaṭṭhānā, tassā cattāri ariyasaccāni padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:43.2: yathāvuttaṃ bhagavatā: “paññindriyaṃ bhikkhave kuhiṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ catusu ariyasaccesu”.
pe6:44.1: cattāri cakkāni: patirūpadesavāso cakkaṃ, sappurisāpassayo cakkaṃ, attasammāpaṇidhānaṃ cakkaṃ, pubbekatapuññatā cakkaṃ,
pe6:44.2: tattha ariyasannissayalakkhaṇo patirūpadesavāso, so sappurisāpassayassa padaṭṭhānaṃ,
pe6:45.3: tattha veramaṇī lakkhaṇaṃ sīlaṃ, taṃ avippaṭisārassa padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:45.4: na attānuvādalakkhaṇo avippaṭisāro, so pāmojjassa padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:45.10: aviparitasantīraṇalakkhaṇā paññā, sā nibbidāya padaṭṭhānaṃ. anālayanalakkhaṇā nibbidā, sā virāgassa padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:45.12: akusaladhammavivekalakkhaṇā vimutti, sā vimuttino vodānassa padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe6:46.2: tattha yo yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. esā dassanabhūmi
pe6:46.3: sotāpattiphalaṃ ca. so yathābhūtaṃ pajānitvā nibbindati, idaṃ tanukāmarāgassa byāpādassa ca padaṭṭhānaṃ sakadāgāmiphalaṃ
pe6:46.4: ca. saṇhaṃ virajjati, ayaṃ rāgavirāgā cetovimutti
pe6:46.5: anāgāmiphalaṃ ca. yā avijjāvirāgā paññāvimutti, ayaṃ katābhūmi
pe6:46.6: arahattañca. sāmaññaphalānīti ko vacanattho, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo sāmaññaṃ, tassetāni phalānīti sāmaññaphalāni vuccanti.
pe6:46.8: brahmaññaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, tassetāni phalānīti brahmaññaphalānīti vuccante.
pe6:47.2: saha saccābhisamayā ariyasāvakassa tīṇi saṃyojanāni pahīyanti: sakkāyadiṭṭhi vicikicchā sīlabbataparāmāso ca. imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānā parikkhayā ariyasāvako hoti avinipātadhammo yāva dukkhassantaṃ karoti.
pe6:48.2: assutavā bālo puthujjano … (yāva) ariyadhamme akovido, so rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, …pe… (yāva) viññāṇasmiṃ attānaṃ. so imesu pañcasu khandhesu attaggāho vā attaniyaggāho vā eso hamasmi ekasmiṃ vasavattiko pakkhitto anuggāho anusayanto aṅgamaṅganti parati,
pe6:48.3: yā tathābhūtassa khanti rucī pekkhanā ākāraparivitakko diṭṭhinijjhāyanā abhippasannā, ayaṃ muccate sakkāyadiṭṭhī’ti.
pe6:49.3: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, yāva viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, imāyo pañca ucchedaṃ bhajanti, avasesāyo pannarasa sassataṃ bhajanti,
pe6:49.5: pahānā ucchedaṃ sassataṃ ca na bhajati.
pe6:49.6: iti ucchedasassatappahānā ariyasāvakassa na kiñci diṭṭhigataṃ bhavati,
pe6:49.8: idha ariyasāvako sutavā hoti. sabbo sukkapakkho kātabbo, yāva ariyadhammesu kovido rūpaṃ anattato samanupassati, yāva viññāṇaṃ …pe…
pe6:50.2: idha ariyasāvako buddhe na kaṅkhati na vicikicchati abhippasīdati, itipi so bhagavā’ti sabbaṃ.
pe6:50.3: dhamme na kaṅkhati na vicikicchati sabbaṃ,
pe6:50.4: yāva taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbāna’nti, iminā dutiyena ākaṅkhīyena dhammena samannāgato hoti.
pe6:50.6: yāva pūjā devānaṃ ca manussānaṃ cā’ti, iminā tatiyena ākaṅkhiyena dhammena samannāgato hoti.
pe6:51.1: ‘sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhā’ti na kaṅkhati na vicikicchati adhimuccati abhippasīdati.
pe6:51.3: taṇhānirodho dukkhanirodho’ti na kaṅkhati na vicikicchati’ariyo
pe6:51.4: aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti na kaṅkhati na vicikicchati adhimuccati abhippasīdati.
pe6:51.5: buddhe vā dhammo vā saṅghe vā dukkhe vā samudaye vā nirodhe vā magge vā kaṅkhāyanā vimati vicikicchā dvedhāpatho āsappanā parisappanā anavaṭṭhānaṃ anadhiṭṭhānaṃ anekaṃso anekaṃsikatā, te tassa pahīnā bhavanti paṇunnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃ gatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
pe6:52.3: tattha katamo, sīlassa sīlabbataparāmāso: imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā, tattha kapotapādāhi accharābhi saddhiṃ kīḷissāmi ramissāmi paricarissāmī’ti.
pe6:52.4: yā tathābhūtassa khanti rucī vimutti rāgo rāgaparivattakā diṭṭhi rūpanā passanā, ayaṃ sīlassa sīlabbatarāmāso.
pe6:52.6: idhekacco sīlaṃ parāmasati: sīlena sujjhati sīlena nīyati sīlena muccati, sukhaṃ vītikkamati, dukkhaṃ vītikkamati, sukhadukkhaṃ vītikkamati, anupāpuṇāti uparimena,
pe6:52.7: tadubhayaṃ sīlavataṃ parāmasati, tadubhayena sīlavatena sujjhanti muccanti nīyanti, sukhaṃ vītikkamanti, dukkhaṃ vītikkamanti, sukhadukkhaṃ vītikkamanti, anupāpuṇantīti avisucīkaraṃ dhammaṃ avimuttikaraṃ dhammaṃ visucīto vimuttito paccāgacchantassa yā tathābhūtassa khanti ruci mutti pekkhanā ākāraparivitakko diṭṭhinijjhāyanā passanā, ayaṃ suddhassa sīlabbataparāmāso.
pe6:52.8: ete ubho parāmāsā ariyasāvakassa pahīnā bhavanti, yāva āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. so sīlavā bhavati ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato akhaṇḍehi yāva upasamasaṃvattanikehi.
pe6:52.9: imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānā sutavā ariyasāvako bhavati sotāpanno avinipātadhammo - sabbaṃ.
pe6:53.2: cattāro abhisamayā: pariññābhisamayo pahānābhisamayo sacchikiriyābhisamayo bhāvanābhisamayo.
pe6:54.1: tattha ariyasāvako dukkhaṃ pariññābhisamayena abhisameti, samudayaṃ pahānābhisamayena abhisameti, nirodhaṃ sacchikiriyābhisamayena abhisameti, maggaṃ bhāvanābhisamayena abhisameti.
pe6:54.3: dukkhassa pariññābhisamayo, samudayassa pahānābhisamayo, nirodhassa sacchikiriyābhisamayo, maggassa bhāvanābhisamayo:
pe6:54.5: ārammaṇe cittaṃ upanibandhetvā pañcakkhandhe dukkhato passati.
pe6:54.8: pañcakkhandhā dukkhāti passato yo pañcakkhandhesu ālayo nikanti upagamanaṃ ajjhosānaṃ icchā mucchā paṇidhi patthanā, so pahīyati.
pe6:54.10: yo tattha ālayo nikanti upagamanaṃ ajjhosānaṃ icchā mucchā paṇidhi patthanā, ayaṃ samudayo.
pe6:54.11: yaṃ tassa pahānaṃ ayaṃ nirodho. samatho vipassanā ca maggo, evaṃ tesaṃ catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ ekakāle ekakkhaṇe ekacitte apubbaṃ acarimaṃ abhisamayo bhavati.
pe6:54.12: tenāha bhagavā: “saha saccābhisamayā ariyasāvakassa tīṇi saṃyojanāni pahīyantī’ti.
pe6:55.1: tattha samathavipassanā yuganaddhā vattamānā ekakāle ekakkhaṇe ekacitte cattāri kiccāni karonti dukkhaṃ pariññābhisamayena abhisameti- yāva maggaṃ bhāvanābhisamayena abhisameti.
pe6:55.4: evaṃ diṭṭhanto: yathā nāvā jalaṃ gacchanti cattāri kiccāni karoti: pārimaṃ tīraṃ pāpeti, orimaṃ tīraṃ jahati, bhāraṃ vahati, sotaṃ chindati.
pe6:55.5: evameva samathavipassanā yuganaddhā vattamānā ekakāle ekakkhaṇe ekacitte cattāri kiccāni karonti: dukkhaṃ pariññābhisamayena abhisameti- yāva maggaṃ bhāvanābhisamayena abhisameti.
pe6:55.6: yathā vā suriyo udayanto ekakāle apubbaṃ acarimaṃ cattāri kiccāni karoti: andhakāraṃ vidhamati, ālokaṃ pātukaroti, rūpaṃ nidassīyati, sītaṃ pariyādiyati,
pe6:55.8: yathā padīpo jalanto ekakāle apubbaṃ acarimaṃ cattāri kiccāni karoti: andhakāraṃ vidhamati, ālokaṃ pātukaroti, rūpaṃ nidassīyati, upādānaṃ pariyādiyati.
pe6:56.1: yadā ariyasāvako sotāpanno bhavati avinipātadhammo niyatoyāva dukkhassantaṃ karoti. ayaṃ dassanabhūmi.
pe6:56.2: sotāpattiphalaṃ ca. sotāpattiphale ṭhito uttariṃ vipassanaṃ bhāvento yuganaddhā vattamānā kāmarāgabyāpādānaṃ yebhuyyena pahānā ariyasāvako hoti
pe6:56.3: sakadāgāmī pariniṭṭhitattā sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti, ayaṃ tanubhūmi.
pe6:57.1: sandhadāgāmiphalaṃ ca. sakadāgāmi phale ṭhito vipassanaṃ bhāvento kāmarāgabyāpāde sānusaye anavasesaṃ pajahati, kāmaragābyāpādesu anavasesaṃ pahīnesu pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni pahīnāni bhavanti: sakkāyadiṭṭhi sīlabbataparāmāso vicikicchā kāmacchando byāpādo ca, imesaṃ pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānā ariyasāvako hoti anāgāmī, tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā, ayaṃ vītarāgabhūmī,
pe6:58.1: anāgāmiphalaṃ ca. anāgāmiphale ṭhito uttariṃ vipassanaṃ bhāvento pañca uddhambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni pajahati: rūparāgo arūparāgo māno uddhaccaṃ avijjā ca.
pe6:58.2: imesaṃ pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānā ariyasāvako arahā bhavati, khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññāvimutto, ayaṃ katābhūmi.
pe6:59.2: tassa āyukkhayā jīvitindriyoparodhā idaṃ ca dukkhaṃ nirujjhati, aññaṃ ca dukkhaṃ na uppajjati,
pe6:59.3: yo imassa dukkhassa nirodho vūpasamo aññassa ca apātūbhāvo, ayaṃ anupādisesā nibbānadhātu.
pe6:59.6: saccābhisamayo vutto, kilesavavatthānaṃ vuttaṃ, pahānaṃ vuttaṃ, bhūmiyo vuttā, phalāni vuttāni, nibbānadhātuyo vuttā,
pe6:60.2: cattāri jhānāni catasso ca arūpasamāpattiyo nirodhasamāpatti ca.
pe6:60.4: “idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi”ti vitthārena kātabbāni.
pe6:60.6: virāgino vata vattabbā, yāva nirodhasamāpatti vitthārena kātabbaṃ.
pe6:61.8: yo pañcasu kāmaguṇesu chandarāgo pemaṃ nikanti ajjhosānaṃ icchā mucchā patthanā apariccāgo anusayo pariyuṭṭhānaṃ, ayaṃ kāmacchando nīvaraṇaṃ.
pe6:61.11: yathā dose tathā vitthāro ayaṃ vyāpādo nīvaraṇaṃ.
pe6:61.13: yā kāyassa jaḍatā kāyassa garuttaṃ. kāyassa akammaniyatā kāyassa nikkhepo niddāyanā pacalāyikatā pacalāyanā pacalāyanaṃ, idaṃ middhaṃ.
pe6:61.15: yā cittassa thīnatā jaḍatā cittassa garuttaṃ cittassa apassaddhi, idaṃ thīnaṃ.
pe6:61.16: iti idaṃ ca thīnaṃ purimakaṃ ca middhaṃ tadubhayaṃ thīnamiddhanīvaraṇanti vuccati.
pe6:61.20: yo cetaso vilekho alañcanā vilañcanā hadayalekho vippaṭisāro, idaṃ kukkuccaṃ.
pe6:61.21: iti idaṃ ca kukkuccaṃ purimakaṃ ca uddhaccaṃ, tadubhayaṃ uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇanti vuccati.
pe6:61.23: yo buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā …pe…
pe6:61.25: api ca kho pana pañca vicikicchāyo: samanantarāyikā desantarāyikā samāpattantarāyikā maggantarāyikā saggantarāyikā, imāyo pañca vicikicchāyo.
pe6:62.4: kāmacchando asubhato nivārayati, byāpādo mettāya nivārayati, thīnaṃ passaddhito nivārayati, middhaṃ viriyārambhato nivārayati, uddhaccaṃ samathato nivārayati, kukkuccaṃ avippaṭisārato nivārayati, vicikicchā paññāto paṭiccasamuppādato nivārayati.
pe6:63.2: kāmacchando alobhato kusalamūlato nivārayati, byāpādo adosato kusalamūlato nivārayati, thīnamiddhaṃ samādhito nivārayati, uddhaccakukkuccaṃ satipaṭṭhānehi nivārayati, vicikicchā amohato kusalamūlato nivārayati.
pe6:64.3: dibbavihāro cattāri jhānāni, brahmavihāro cattāri appamāṇāni ariyavihāro sattatiṃsa bodhipakkhiyā dhammā,
pe6:64.4: tattha kāmacchando uddhaccaṃ kukkuccaṃ ca dibbavihāraṃ nivārayati, byāpādo brahmavihāraṃ nivārayati, thīnamiddhaṃ vicikicchā ca ariyavihāraṃ nivārayati.
pe6:65.2: kāmacchando byāpādo uddhaccakukkuccaṃ ca samathaṃ nivārayanti, thīnamiddhaṃ vicikicchā ca vipassanaṃ nivārayanti. ato nīvaraṇanti vuccante.
pe6:65.3: imehi pañcahi aṅgehi vippayuttaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ.
pe6:66.1: katamehi pañcahi aṅgehi sampayuttaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ:
pe6:66.2: vitakkavicārehi pītiyā sukhena ca cittekaggatāya ca.
pe6:66.3: imesaṃ pañcannaṃ aṅgānaṃ uppādapaṭilābhasamannāgatāya sacchikiriyāya paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ paṭiladdhanti vuccati.
pe6:66.4: imāni pañca aṅgāni uppādetvā viharatīti tena vuccate paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja dibbena vihārena viharatīti.
pe6:67.1: tattha dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ caturaṅgasamannāgataṃ: pītiyā sukhena cittekaggatāya ajjhattaṃ sampasādanena, imāni cattāri aṅgāni uppādetvā sampādetvā viharati, tena vuccati dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatīti.
pe6:68.1: tattha pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ: satiyā sampajaññena sukhena cittekaggatāya upekkhāya, imāni pañcaṅgāni uppādetvā sampādetvā viharati, tena vuccati tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatīti.
pe6:69.1: tattha catutthaṃ jhānaṃ caturaṅgasamannāgataṃ: upekkhāya satipārisuddhiyā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya cittekaggatāya ca, imehi catūhaṅgehi samannāgataṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ.
pe6:69.2: iti imesaṃ catunnaṃ aṅgānaṃ uppādapaṭilābhasamannāgatāya sacchikiriyāya catutthaṃ jhānaṃ paṭiladdhanti vuccati.
pe6:69.3: imāni cattāri jhānāni uppādetvā sampādetvā upasampajja viharati. tena vuccati ‘dibbena vihārena viharatī’ti.
pe6:70.2: pīḷanaṭṭho aniccaṭṭho, pabhaṅgaṭṭho sampāpanaṭṭho vivekaṭṭho aniccaṭṭho, ayaṃ aniccaṭṭho.
pe6:71.2: pīḷanaṭṭho dukkhaṭṭho sampīḷanaṭṭho saṃvegaṭṭho byābādhanaṭṭho dukkhaṭṭho, ayaṃ dukkhaṭṭho.
pe6:72.2: anupalittaṭṭho suññaṭṭho asambhajanaṭṭho vigataṭṭho vivattaṭṭho suññaṭṭho. ayaṃ suññaṭṭho.
pe6:73.2: anissariyaṭṭho anattaṭṭho avasavattanaṭṭho akāmakāriṭṭho parividaṭṭho anattaṭṭho. ayaṃ anattaṭṭho’ti. peṭakopadese
